svg.title: Tower concept 2 — Faceted keep
svg.desc: A tall octagonal watchtower with a slightly tapered shaft and four large raised parapet blocks. The large facets and high crown make the tower stronger than the low pointed redoubt. Pure vector artwork, transparent background, shared lower anchor at y=458, light from upper left. No embedded images, textures, fonts or external resources. Stronger warm stone contours and more contrasting side planes clarify the existing edges without adding decorative detail.
